ED-06 / SPK-02 — the authenticated route through the real ingress
retainedCriteria.name: AC-14 [ED-06, SPK-02 question 4, Platform/SRE (ingress)] — a 15 s HEARTBEAT KEEPS AN IDLE STREAM OPEN across the ingress and any platform proxy, and the EFFECTIVE MAXIMUM STREAM LIFETIME is measured against the intended 60 s. If the effective maximum is BELOW the configured lifetime, the configured value moves to match the measurement and the change is recorded — studioSse.lifetimeSeconds is a §8.5 starting value, not a commitment, and the ingress timeout is derived from it so it moves too. That is the mechanism working, not a criterion failing. Nothing in this repository can measure a proxy it has never crossed.

retainedCriteria.name: AC-15 [ED-06, SPK-02 question 5, Platform/SRE (ingress) + backend dev] — RECONNECT WITH Last-Event-ID TO A DIFFERENT API REPLICA restores the current snapshot. The evidence must show the two connections were served by DIFFERENT PODS: a reconnect that happens to land on the same replica proves nothing and is the way this criterion gets reported passed without being tested. Trading a design property for a deployment workaround would close this criterion by defeating the thing it exists to check.

retainedCriteria.name: AC-23b [staging; ED-06/ED-05 and the spikes; Platform/SRE] — KILL SWITCH, DRAIN, RECOVERY AND BOUNDED OVERLOAD OBSERVED AGAINST THE DEPLOYED STACK, with ordinary REST/check service preserved.
